english.note: Use this when the thing is superfluous or an unwanted extra, rather than merely not required.
This is the all-purpose choice for something unnecessary or extra, including words that add no useful content.
This is the all-purpose choice for something unnecessary or extra.
This is the all-purpose choice for something extra, unnecessary, or not wanted, such as 多餘時間.
Use 多餘 when something is surplus or adds nothing useful, rather than simply not being required.
Use this when the extra thing is surplus, unnecessary, or not wanted, rather than merely additional.
Use this when the thing is unwanted, extraneous, or getting in the way rather than fake.
Use this especially for a stray comma or other mark that should not be there because it is extra.

examples.english: You don't need to buy another one; the one at home still works, so another one would be needless.
This button is redundant; it makes no difference whether you press it.
examples.traditional: 呢個按鈕係多餘，撳唔撳都冇分別。
